Message:
feat(WP-036B S1 0144E4): strict-port q3_new, nn, and scalr_enhanced acceptance tests

Sub-pass 4/6 of the WP-036B strict-port decomposition (amendment #35).
Import-only ports of the three PRINet 3.0 reference tests
(test_q3_new.py 31/389, test_nn.py 30/712, test_scalr_enhanced.py 14/649 —
75 functions / 1,750 lines); all 75 collect and pass with 0 skips, 0
tolerance annotations. Missing compatibility behaviour is rebuilt behind
Rust-backed owners with thin Python delegation:

- nn/optimizers.py: new SynchronizedGradientDescent / RIPOptimizer /
  SCALROptimizer classes reproducing the full PRINet 3.0 nn.optimizers API
  (metric histories, compute_sync_penalty, per-frequency order-parameter
  dicts, EMA-adaptive r_min). Every parameter tensor update delegates to the
  SyncGdBridge / RipBridge / ScalrBridge; only scalar order-parameter
  feedback bookkeeping is mirrored in Python (round-tripped through the
  ScalrBridge JSON state), the same split as the existing compute_lr_scale
  helper. prin._compat re-exports these instead of aliasing Scalr/Rip/SyncGd.
- prin-dynamics integrate.rs: overflow-safe adaptive_krylov_dim (saturating
  cast/add before the existing clamp) so ExponentialIntegrator stiff_mode
  no longer panics.
- _torch_compat.ExponentialIntegrator: stiff_mode property; treat dim as
  PRINet 3.0's advisory Krylov-threshold hint and build the Rust owner
  lazily from the real 3*n state size.
- prin-py train.rs: ResonanceLayerBridge.order_parameter (Rust-owned
  Kuramoto order parameter via prin_metrics); ResonanceLayer gains
  get_order_parameter, unbatched forward, and PRINet-3.0 parameter mirrors.
- DentateGyrusConverter re-exported from _torch_compat.
- DGLayer / PhaseToRateAutoencoder / PRINetModel gain value-preserving
  torch.nn.Parameter mirrors for introspection / oscillatory_weight_init.
- benchmarks/oscillobench.py: import-adapted support module for
  test_q3_new's OscilloBench cases (clevr_n import stays lazy for 0144E5).

Legacy-test updates for the widened surface (E3 precedent):
test_train_bridge 1d-input test now asserts acceptance; test_api_surface
pure-rename test reflects the three optimizers as standalone
torch.optim.Optimizer subclasses. Migration guide symbol wording updated.
Corrected 0144E3's stale brief status (PLANNED -> COMPLETE), restoring the
session-plan validator gate.
